task: Write an async Python function poll_until_ready(check) that calls the async callable check() every 2 seconds until it returns True, giving up after 30 seconds.

constraints.text: inside async functions, delays go through asyncio.sleep; blocking time.sleep froze the event loop in production
constraints.why: a time.sleep call inside a coroutine stalled every request handler for 12 seconds during the May outage

checks.description: calls blocking time.sleep in async code

constraints.text: polling loops track an explicit deadline (loop.time, time.monotonic, or asyncio.wait_for) instead of counting iterations
constraints.why: an iteration-counting poller overshot its time budget when call latency spiked in May

checks.description: no deadline mechanism; likely counts iterations
